name: pq-healthshield-hub
description: Admin portal that provisions per-client VxSync vaccination-tracker deployments and issues SSO tokens for a connected 3-app system. Google Apps Script API + Supabase backend, static frontend.

paragraphs: An internal operations portal I designed and built for a healthcare logistics company to replace a patchwork of manual spreadsheets and one-off Google Apps Script tools with a single, role-based system for managing client vaccination-program deployments end to end.

This repo is a sanitized copy of a real internal system. Real IDs, API keys, company names, and personal data have been replaced with bracketed placeholders like [COMPANYNAME], [SHEETID], YOUR-PROJECT-REF, etc. It is not runnable as-is without plugging in your own Supabase project, Google Cloud OAuth credentials, and Netlify site.

requirements.text: The per-client tracker is deployed with Apps Script's executeAs: "USERACCESSING", so it runs as whichever Google account is actually signed in — meaning an assigned encoder also needs real Drive "writer" permission on that client's underlying Sheet, or every call in the app throws a permission error with no obvious cause.
